title: Fancy Yellow cushion diamond three-stone ring
subtitle: A Fancy Yellow cushion at this size presents its color across a wide face. The three-stone format was chosen so nothing interrupts that presentation: two Cadillac-cut white diamonds flank the center, clean geometric frames that direct attention inward rather than competing outward. One stone center, two decisions about how to hold it.
